capture.text: The time has come to give my final and proper "Closure" to my long career.This is my official retirement statement to all my fans, my supporters, my followers, and my haters — it contains everything that everyone needs to know regard my retirement decision, about my experiences over the years, and about my growth as a person.your task is :1—fully read it - do not skip parts.2—spread and share it far and wide.3—embrace the change and the new era.
